season.evidence: Logged Banded Glacier ascents: Jun 5, Jul 10, Aug 1; all-routes histogram peaks July (118), Aug 46, Jun 22, Sep 15. Web results (Mountaineers and guide pages) give July through September, wait until late July after a snowy year, and one late-season Banded report said a month earlier would have been better. Stored Jun-Aug kept, best July.

track.why: 20 Jul 2019, logged route Banded Glacier, start trailhead Easy Pass (24 m from our pin), summit 52 m from our pin and 2 m from the surveyed coordinate, round trip, summited, glacier climb gear. Logged route name and approach match our route.

facts.text: In late June the Easy Pass trail can vanish under snow near the top; keep traversing west at pass level before picking up the switchbacks down to Fisher Creek.
At the col above the lake camp, the narrow eastern notch gave an easier downclimb on snow-free scree than the wider western one in late June.
Late June can work: the glacier was low-angle with no open cracks, easy snow on the climber's left leads to a roped finish near the Banded-Douglas col, then an exposed class 4 summit block.

season.evidence: Only two logged Douglas ascents (Jun, Sep); guide pages say July through September and note slide alder in the upper Douglas Creek in summer. Stored Jun-Sep kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 21 Jun 2014 Douglas Glacier ascent, summited, but no GPS track harvested.

facts.text: In late June, old slide debris and a cornice sit on the traverse to the Banded-Douglas col, and afternoon warmth set off a soft-snow slide near the east ridge above the lower basin.
In late June the Easy Pass trail is mostly clear for the first mile or two, then lost under snow; past the pass the trail continues west at pass level.
A short rappel from the false summit drops to the saddle before the final class 4 summit block.

notes: Fremont Glacier (wa_mount_logan_fremont_glacier) already has a track and is the Thunder Creek route; all Thunder Creek tracks belong there. Easy Pass trailhead pin is stored for both routes; no pins proposed.
